description:
🐻 About Alan

In Spain, many people struggle to get timely care because of long waiting times, limited access or a lack of time. Alan was built to change that. We combine health insurance and a virtual clinic in one app, so we can be a real health partner for our members.

The Alan Clinic brings together more than 120 health professionals, available 7 days a week: GPs, midwives, psychologists, physiotherapists, dermatologists, paediatricians, nutritionists and paediatric nurses.

Our members get truly integrated care:

  • 🩺 Video consultations for situations that do not need a live medical appointment

  • 💬 Mo, our AI health companion, which instantly answers everyday health questions. Its answers are reviewed and approved by our doctors.

  • 🎯 Prevention programmes (back pain, stress management) that are guided and personalised

  • 🧘 Alan Play, a playful approach to prevention built around physical activity, mental wellbeing and team spirit

🩺 What you'll do

  • Run video consultations with our members and give them clear, high-quality medical advice

  • Help with the medical review of Mo, our AI health companion, so its answers stay accurate and safe

  • Share your clinical expertise to help shape how AI is used in patient care

🔍 Who we're looking for

We're hiring general practitioners who are comfortable with remote medicine and keen to join our video consultation team.

  • ✅ Medical degree valid in Spain, with the family medicine specialty (MIR)

  • ✅ Active registration with a Colegio Oficial de Médicos (colegiado) and valid work permit

  • ✅ Professional liability insurance that covers telemedicine (seguro de responsabilidad civil)

  • ✅ Working as a self-employed doctor (autónomo)

  • ✅ Currently practising in a medical centre

  • ✅ Fluent Spanish and English

  • ✅ Available at least 5 hours a week, on flexible hours and different days

  • ✅ 2 years of work experience (previous experience with Video-consultation is a plus)

  • ✅ Excited about bringing AI into your practice

  • ✅ Convinced that prevention and ongoing support make a real difference to patients' lives

🙌 Why join Alan?

  • 🏥 A structured medical framework. You work within clear guidelines that meet regulatory and ethical requirements, so care stays consistent, aligned and safe. Lead doctors support you with difficult clinical cases.

  • 🤝 A medical community. You join a team of health professionals (doctors, therapists and specialists) to discuss complex cases, share best practices and grow together.

  • 🤖 Help shape the future of medicine. What role should AI play in patient care? At Alan, doctors lead that conversation and are directly involved in building our AI.

  • 💰 Attractive terms. Lots of flexibility in how you organise your time and the chance to grow within a committed medical community.
